title: The Third Turn
lines: Meg and Kurt run on the dirt path.
Meg gets the first turn on the sled.
Kurt has to stand and rest.
Then Kurt gets his turn on it.
He bumps a rock and lands in dirt.
His shirt gets dirt all on it.
Meg helps him up with her hand.
She rubs the dirt off his shirt.
Kurt grins and gets a third turn.
This time he did not fall.

questions.ask: Who got the first turn on the sled?
questions.listenFor: Meg. Kurt had to stand and rest. It is in the second and third lines.
He bumped a rock, landed in the dirt, and his arm hurt a bit. Listen for the rock, not just 'he fell.'

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was a good friend? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for the reason, like helping him up, or rubbing the dirt off his shirt.
